nodes.label: --brand-white (#FFFFFF)
nodes.rationale: The default light slide surface (--surface-slide) and the invert text colour on dark (--text-invert). Ink on white measures 8.6:1.

nodes.label: --brand-snow (#EEF2F8)
nodes.rationale: The one tint above white. Serves double duty as card surface (--surface-card) and table header (--surface-table-head), and as the background behind mono code blocks -- one tint instead of a grey ramp keeps light surfaces from multiplying.

nodes.label: --brand-snow-line (hairline border)
nodes.rationale: The single 1px separator colour, aliased as --rule-hairline. Because the system caps elevation at a 2px lift, this hairline is what actually delineates cards and swatches -- not shadow.

nodes.label: Card on dark (#1B2E56)
nodes.rationale: The raised card value used on top of the deep slide surface. Sits one step lighter than brand-deep so a card reads as raised without needing a shadow. Not present in the published semantic alias list.

hyperedges.label: Light/dark surfaces and the two sanctioned text pairings
